d:
Join Veggie Paaji on an exciting culinary adventure in Patna, Bihar, as he kicks off his "Patna Food Series"! In this first episode, we explore the bustling streets around Patna Junction Railway Station to discover the most authentic and delicious vegetarian street food.
Highlights of our incredible food journey:
Chaurasiya Ji Ki Purani Litti Dukaan: Savor the legendary Litti Chokha [00:06], a Bihar staple that has been delighting locals since 1956! Experience the perfectly baked sattu-stuffed littis served with flavorful chokha.
